description: The file defines the MyReviewAPI class, which extends Endpoint and implements the CrudEndpoint interface. It provides an API endpoint to retrieve a list of performance reviews associated with the authenticated user, including handling pagination, sorting, and filtering. It uses traits for authentication and performance review services, and returns detailed review models within a structured API response.

classes.name: MyReviewAPI
classes.description: API class for handling user-specific performance review listings, extending endpoint functionalities and implementing CRUD interface with only the 'list' method implemented.

methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a paginated, filtered list of performance reviews for the authenticated user, returning them in a structured API result.
